segment.description: Pine Creek (GNIS 01314030) of DeKalb County, the Caney Fork/Center Hill fringe tributary near Smithville that runs ENE from headwaters ~35.93,-85.86 to its mouth in the Center Hill Lake pool at ~35.911,-85.712. Identity pinned by catalog HUC 05130108 (Caney) plus USGS/TDEC: all Pine Creek stations in DeKalb carry HUC 05130108 (same-name Pine Creeks in Scott Co. and elsewhere are different waters).
segment.boundaries: Catalog: TWRA spring-stocked DeKalb County creek in the Center Hill fringe (no reach limits given). TWRA stocking sites, both spring program, 900 rainbow each: S1 Big Rock Rd. Bridge Crossing 35.9080,-85.7715 and S2 Student Home Rd. Bridge Crossing 35.9048,-85.7840. The TDEC temperature record (TDECWPC-PINE005.7DB, 35.9077,-85.7712) sits at the Big Rock Rd crossing, i.e. inside the stocked reach.

coldSource.notes: Free-flowing tributary entering the Center Hill Lake pool well upstream of Center Hill Dam; no dam on the stocked reach. A USGS station named 'PINE CREEK SPRINGS NEAR SMITHVILLE, TN' (03422619) documents a mapped spring site in this drainage but has no published data series - not sufficient to call the creek spring-fed. Caney Fork tailwater stocking sites (Long Branch / Buffalo Valley recreation areas) in the same county are a DIFFERENT water (the Caney Fork itself) and were excluded.

holdover.detail: No holdover documentation found; TWRA's program here is seasonal spring put-and-take rainbow (2026 schedule: weeks of 2/22, 3/22 and 3/29 only).

wildPopulation.detail: No wild trout documentation found. The creek has no entry (special regulation or wild-trout listing) on TWRA's Tennessee Trout Regulations page as fetched 2026-09-18.

overallSurvivalRead.oneLineWhy: TDEC grabs at the stocked Big Rock Rd crossing (2003-2008) show July-August water peaking at 19.96 C - cool enough that summer trout survival is physically plausible - but the stocking program is spring-only and no holdover or wild-trout evidence exists, so year-round survival is unproven in both directions.
